rows.source_ko: 과학기술정보통신부 (연구산업진흥과), 044-202-4732,4738
rows.text_en: Ministry of Science and ICT ( Research Industry Promotion Division ), 044-202-4732, 4738

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「산업기술연구조합 육성법」 및 동법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 관하여 필요한 사항을 정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2006. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Industrial Technology Research Association Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for their implementation. <Amended Sep. 25, 2006>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(조합설립인가신청서) 「산업기술연구조합 육성법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제2조제1항의 규정에 의한 산업기술연구조합(이하 “조합”이라 한다)의 설립인가신청서는 별지 제1호서식에 의한다. <개정 2006. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Application for Approval of Establishment of an Association) An application for approval of the establishment of an industrial technology research association (hereinafter referred to as the “Association”) pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Industrial Technology Research Association Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be made using Form No. 1 attached hereto. <Amended Sep. 25, 2006>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(조합설립인가서의 교부) 과학기술정보통신부장관은 「산업기술연구조합 육성법」 제8조제1항 및 영 제2조제2항의 규정에 의하여 조합의 설립인가를 한 때에는 그 신청인에게 별지 제2호서식에 의한 조합설립인가서를 교부하여야 한다. <개정 2001. 7. 13., 2006. 9. 25., 2008. 3. 3., 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Issuance of Certificate of Approval for Establishment of an Association) When the Minister of Science and ICT approves the establishment of an Association pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Industrial Technology Research Association Promotion Act and Article 2, Paragraph 2 of the Decree, the Minister shall issue the applicant a certificate of approval for establishment of the Association in Form No. 2 attached hereto. <Amended Jul. 13, 2001; Sep. 25, 2006; Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013; Jul. 26, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(정관변경인가신청서의 첨부서류) 영 제4조의 규정에 의하여 정관변경인가신청서에 첨부하여야 할 서류는 다음 각호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Documents to Be Attached to an Application for Approval of Amendments to the Articles of Association) Pursuant to Article 4 of the Decree, the following documents shall be attached to an application for approval of amendments to the Articles of Association:

rows.source_ko: 1. 정관변경안 2부
rows.text_en: 1. Two copies of the Proposed Amendment to the Articles of Incorporation

rows.source_ko: 2. 정관변경이유서 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of the statement of reasons for amendment of the Articles of Incorporation

rows.source_ko: 3. 정관변경에 관한 총회의사록 1부
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of the minutes of the General Meeting regarding the amendment of the Articles of Incorporation

rows.source_ko: 4. 정관변경의 원인이 되는 사실을 증명할 수 있는 서류 1부
rows.text_en: 4. One copy of documents proving the facts constituting the cause of the amendment to the Articles of Incorporation
Article 5 Deleted <July 13, 2001>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(우선구매등의 조치요청서등) 조합의 조합원은 영 제9조제1항의 규정에 의하여 우선구매등의 조치요청을 하고자 할 때에는 별지 제3호서식에 의한 우선구매등의 조치요청서에 다음 각호의 서류를 첨부하여 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Request for Measures such as Preferential Purchase) When a member of the Association intends to request measures such as preferential purchase pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Decree, the member shall submit a request in Form No. 3 attached hereto, together with the following documents.

rows.source_ko: 1. 제품명세서 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the product specification

rows.source_ko: 2. 사업계획서 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of the business plan

rows.source_ko: 3. 당해조합의 연구성과임을 증명하는 서류 1부
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of a document proving that the research results were produced by the relevant association

rows.source_ko: 제7조(사업실적 및 결산서의 제출) 영 제10조의 규정에 의한 사업실적과 결산에 관한 보고서는 별지 제4호서식에 의한다. 이 경우 사업실적과 결산에 관한 보고서에는 다음 각호의 서류를 첨부하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 3., 2013. 3. 24., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Submission of Business Performance and Settlement of Accounts) The report on business performance and settlement of accounts pursuant to Article 10 of the Decree shall be in Form No. 4 attached hereto. The following documents shall be attached to the report. <Amended Mar. 3, 2008; Mar. 24, 2013; Jul. 26, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 업무현황 1부
rows.text_en: 1. Work Status (1 copy)

rows.source_ko: 2. 재산목록 1부
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of the inventory of assets

rows.source_ko: 3. 공인회계사의 감사증명서 1부(과학기술정보통신부장관이 첨부하게 한 때에 한한다)
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of an audit certificate from a Certified Public Accountant (limited to cases where the Minister of Science and ICT requires attachment)
[Wholly Amended Jan. 14, 2003]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(과태료의 징수절차) 영 제11조제4항에 따른 과태료의 징수절차는 「국고금관리법 시행규칙」을 준용한다. 이 경우에 납입고지서에는 납입방법 및 납입기간 등을 함께 기재하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Procedures for Collection of Administrative Fines) The procedures for collecting administrative fines pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 4 of the Decree shall be governed mutatis mutandis by the Enforcement Rule of the National Treasury Management Act. In this case, the payment notice shall specify the method and period of payment.
[This Article was newly established on September 25, 2006.]
ADDENDA <Prime Minister's Decree No. 324, Apr. 9, 1987>
